extensions.plugins.plugin-on-off.why: Per plugin: each plugin's switch writes this map.
extensions.plugins.plugin-on-off.label: Which plugins are on

extensions.plugins.add-from-catalog.why: The Add plugin button (From the catalog).
extensions.plugins.add-from-catalog.actionLabel: Add a plugin from the catalog

extensions.plugins.add-local.why: The Add plugin button (From a folder).
extensions.plugins.add-local.actionLabel: Add a plugin from a folder

extensions.plugins.remove.why: Per plugin: Remove plugin in its panel.
routeToast: Remove plugin is at the bottom of its panel.

extensions.plugins.auto-enable-new.label: Turn new plugins on right away
extensions.plugins.auto-enable-new.help: Off means a new plugin arrives switched off, so new code never runs before you've looked at it.

extensions.plugins.hook-timeout.label: Time limit for each plugin step
extensions.plugins.hook-timeout.help: A plugin that takes longer is stopped. Raise it only for a plugin you trust.

extensions.plugins.tool-override.label: Let plugins change the app's own tools
extensions.plugins.tool-override.help: Off keeps built-in tools working the way they're described. A warning shows while it's on.
